name: Declaration BIP
description: Base Information Package defining the core declaration structure shared across all declaration types
pakRelevance: FOUNDATION — Underlies all WeBOC GD types

name: Response BIP
description: Base Information Package for all customs response messages — decisions, releases, queries, errors
pakRelevance: FOUNDATION — Maps to WeBOC response messages

name: Cross-Border Movement BIP
description: Base Information Package for cross-border goods movement covering transport and routing
pakRelevance: FOUNDATION — Underlies all movement types (sea, air, land, rail)

name: Goods Declaration
description: Import/export goods declaration — the core customs document for clearance of goods
pakRelevance: PRIMARY — Maps to WeBOC GD (Home Consumption, Export, Warehousing)

name: Cargo Declaration (Manifest)
description: Cargo manifest declaration for arriving/departing conveyances — IGM and EGM
pakRelevance: PRIMARY — Maps to IGM (Import General Manifest) and EGM in WeBOC

name: Conveyance Report
description: Report on the arriving/departing conveyance including crew, stores, and cargo summary
pakRelevance: SECONDARY — Vessel/aircraft arrival/departure reports at ports

name: Advanced Electronic Information (AEI/SAFE)
description: Pre-arrival advance cargo information per WCO SAFE Framework of Standards
pakRelevance: HIGH — NTC pre-arrival risk targeting for imports

name: Transit Declaration
description: Declaration for goods moving under customs transit across the territory
pakRelevance: HIGH — Afghan Transit Trade (ATTA), CPEC transit movements

name: License/Permit/Certificate
description: Supporting regulatory documents — import/export licences, permits from OGAs
pakRelevance: HIGH — 70+ OGAs issue L/P/C via Pakistan Single Window (PSW)

name: Phytosanitary Certificate
description: Certificate for plant health clearance per IPPC standards
pakRelevance: HIGH — DPP (Dept of Plant Protection) certificates for agri exports

name: Veterinary Certificate
description: Certificate for animal health and food safety clearance
pakRelevance: HIGH — AQSD certificates for livestock/meat/dairy

name: Certificate of Origin (v4.2)
description: Certificate proving the origin of goods for preferential tariff treatment
pakRelevance: HIGH — CPFTA-II, SAFTA, GSP+ preference claims

name: Customs Bond (v4.2)
description: Customs bond and guarantee information for securing duty obligations
pakRelevance: HIGH — Surety bonds for warehousing, transit, temporary admission

name: Booking Reservation Information (v4.1)
description: Advance booking and reservation of transport capacity
pakRelevance: LOW — Shipping line booking (not customs-managed)

name: Postal/E-Commerce Items
description: Cross-border e-commerce and postal shipment declarations
pakRelevance: GROWING — Pakistan Post, courier companies (DHL, FedEx, TCS)

name: Temporary Admission
description: Declaration for temporary import of goods with re-export obligation
pakRelevance: MEDIUM — Exhibition goods, project equipment, vehicles

name: ATA Carnet
description: International customs document for temporary admission under ATA Convention
pakRelevance: LOW — Limited ATA carnet usage in Pakistan

name: Passenger Declaration
description: Customs declaration for passenger accompanied baggage
pakRelevance: MEDIUM — Airport passenger customs (green/red channel)

name: GOVCBR (Gov Cross-Border Regulatory)
description: Government cross-border regulatory information exchange between agencies
pakRelevance: HIGH — Inter-agency risk data sharing (NTC, ANF, ISI)

name: Warehouse Declaration
description: Declaration for placing goods in a customs bonded warehouse
pakRelevance: HIGH — WeBOC WH type GDs, bonded warehousing

name: Free Zone Declaration
description: Declaration for goods entering or leaving a free trade zone
pakRelevance: GROWING — Gwadar Free Zone, CPEC SEZs

name: Re-Export Declaration
description: Declaration for re-export of previously imported goods
pakRelevance: MEDIUM — Re-export from bonded warehouses, transit goods

name: Drawback Claim
description: Claim for refund of duties paid on imported inputs used in exported goods
pakRelevance: HIGH — Duty drawback claims by export manufacturers
